description: Write a short note on an issue's timeline so the owner sees what you're doing: you started, opened a pull request (include its URL), or deployed the fix. Needs write access. Notes are shown as written by an agent.

link.description: Pull request, commit or deploy URL (https)

status.description: investigating = you started; pr_opened = a pull request exists (pass link); deployed = the fix is live; note = anything else

name: add_note
title: Post progress on an issue
